rooms.name: Village Gate
rooms.description: A heavy stone gate stands tall. To the north is the Marketplace.

rooms.name: Marketplace
rooms.description: Lively vendors cry out their wares. Exits lead South, West, North, and East.

rooms.name: Old Tavern
rooms.description: Warmth radiates from within. The smell of roasted meat lingers. Exits West.

rooms.name: Alchemist Shop
rooms.description: Vials glimmer on shelves. It smells of sulfur.

rooms.name: Mysterious Forest
rooms.description: Trees loom high above, blocking much of the sun.

items.name: Village Sign
items.description: A wooden signpost. The arrows point North to the Marketplace; the Old Tavern is east of the market.

items.name: Gold Key
items.description: A small gold key, warm to the touch.

items.name: Chest
items.description: A sturdy oak chest, bound in rusted iron.

items.name: Brass Lantern
items.description: A brass lantern, its wick still dry.
